description: Sets the topic for one of the person's curiosities: an existing topic by interest_id, or a new one by label (a few words). Takes effect immediately; nothing is reviewed. A curiosity that already has a topic keeps it. Topic labels are shared: any connected client can list them, never with who holds them.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

curiosity_id.description: A curiosity id the person owns that has no topic yet.

label.description: A NEW interest, a few words, in the person's own framing.

name: propose_interest
title: Name a Curiosity’s Topic
